description.narrative: Compagnie Financière Africaine (COFINA) is a leading mesofinance institution that provides loans to businesses in West and Central Africa to enable them to develop and grow their business._x000D_ _x000D_ Investment will support entrepreneurship in West Africa, empowering underserved groups, including women entrepreneurs. The investment is expected to contribute to job creation and business growth and improved livelihoods._x000D_ _x000D_ Swedfund’s loan will target the underserved segments of MSMEs, women entrepreneurs and agribusinesses in Côte d’Ivoire and Senegal._x000D_ _x000D_ Swedfund’s investment enables small and medium-sized enterprises to access long-term finance, contributing to economic growth, jobs and other income-generating opportunities locally. Furthermore, the investment contributes to the economic empowerment of women by promoting female leadership, increasing the number of jobs for women, and offering products and services that favour women.
